login.subLogin: User authentication — the session is a signed HttpOnly cookie, valid for hours, sent by the browser on its own.
login.subActivate: First access (DA-55): confirm the token sent to your e-mail, then the code sent to your phone.
login.emailConfirmed: E-mail confirmed — now the code sent to your phone.
login.accountActivated: Account activated — sign in with username and password.
login.foot: Integrations do not sign in here: they use the X-API-Key header (curl, MCP, A2A) — each credential in its own layer.

auth.tooMany: Too many attempts — wait a minute

diagnose.title: Incident diagnosis
diagnose.subtitle: Describe the incident in plain language. The agent retrieves context through RAG, analyzes it with an LLM and returns the probable root cause with concrete next steps.
diagnose.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g.: IDoc stuck in status 51 — material not found in the production plant.
diagnose.logsPlaceholder: Paste the relevant logs from the iFlow, SM21, ST22, etc.
diagnose.payloadPlaceholder: XML payload, error JSON, ABAP exception message, etc.
diagnose.needDescription: Describe the incident to start the diagnosis.
diagnose.fileTooLarge: File too large. Limit: {{kb}} KB (the same character limit the API accepts for logs/payload).

demo.cpi401: iFlow returning HTTP 401 when authenticating through OAuth2
demo.connRefused: SM59 cannot connect to the target system

details.note: Informative signal: no paid model was called because of it.

reasons.grounded: Sufficient evidence in the curated knowledge base.
reasons.no_context: No context: no connector data and no retrieved document.
reasons.abstained: The guardrails discarded the source: the answer is unsupported.
reasons.floor_tier_weak: Only generic manuals support the answer, and the evidence is weak.
reasons.curated_tier_weak: A curated document exists, but the reranker did not support the match.
